description: Address v2 QA review issues: (1) Static CORS in shared helpers rateLimit.ts and iaCredits.ts bypass per-request CORS computed in proxy-ai, (2) No try-catch in OraculoBar unknown-intent branch leaves UI stuck in busy state on error.
steps: Fix supabase/functions/_shared/rateLimit.ts: Make tooManyRequests() accept an optional corsHeaders parameter (Record<string,string>). If provided, use those headers; if not, fall back to the existing static default.

Fix supabase/functions/_shared/iaCredits.ts: Make checkAndConsumeCredit() accept an optional corsOverride parameter (Record<string,string>). If provided, use those headers in the Response it builds instead of the static CORS constant.
Fix supabase/functions/proxy-ai/index.ts: Pass the local `cors` headers to both tooManyRequests() and checkAndConsumeCredit() calls.
Fix src/features/omicron/components/OraculoBar.tsx: Wrap the unknown-intent branch in try-catch-finally with setBusy(false) in the finally block.
acceptance_criteria: tooManyRequests() accepts optional corsHeaders and uses them when provided
checkAndConsumeCredit() accepts optional corsOverride and uses them when provided
proxy-ai passes its local cors headers to both shared helpers
OraculoBar unknown branch has try-catch-finally with setBusy(false) in finally
verification: source /root/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22 && ./node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | grep -v 'react-router-dom' | grep error || echo 'No new TS errors'
source /root/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22 && npx vitest --run 2>&1 | tail -20
findings: All v2 review issues addressed. Build passes (only pre-existing react-router-dom error). All 127 tests pass. CORS helpers are now backwards-compatible (optional param with static fallback).
